description: This file defines the interface for GuzzleHttp's HTTP client, specifying methods for sending HTTP requests synchronously and asynchronously, as well as configuration options.

methods.name: send
methods.description: Sends an HTTP request synchronously and returns a ResponseInterface.

methods.name: sendAsync
methods.description: Sends an HTTP request asynchronously and returns a PromiseInterface.

methods.name: request
methods.description: Creates and sends an HTTP request with specified method, URI, and options synchronously.

methods.name: requestAsync
methods.description: Creates and sends an HTTP request with specified method, URI, and options asynchronously.

methods.name: getConfig
methods.description: Retrieves a client configuration option, deprecated in favor of newer methods.
